0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7, 3rd in the Southeast and 2.5 games back, 9th in the East) are on the road against the Phoenix Suns (4-6, 3rd in the Pacific and 5 games back, 11th in the West), with Charlotte 1-3 away and Phoenix 4-3 at home and 0-3 on the road. Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder (out, hamstring strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain), while Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Hornets winning the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
